verdict.rationale: Elicit has a public pricing page that lists features by plan (Zotero import, API access, RIS/CSV/BIB/PDF/DOCX export), and its docs name Pro, Scale, and Enterprise tiers and gate Systematic Review table exports to them. That gives a researcher some view of what each plan includes before committing, but the pack shows no actual prices or usage limits. Missing for 10: actual plan prices, documented usage limits or quotas (credits, papers, sessions), free-tier limits, and independent corroboration of pricing clarity.
